n_c2s1_intro.text: The king's messengers came up to Bethlehem, to the house of Jesse, with a word from Saul.

1sam16_19.text: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

n_c2s1_flock.text: But the flock was still his to answer for. He could not go until another man could keep it.

n_c2s1_keeper.text: A hired man was waiting at the day fold: a keeper, to have the flock while he was gone.

n_c2s1_names.text: A keeper who cannot tell them apart cannot tell which one is missing. So he showed him the ones that answer to a name.

n_c2s1_count.text: Nine went under the rod, and the keeper counted them after him.

n_c2s1_well.text: He showed him the well: where the stone is levered from, and how much the trough must hold.

n_c2s1_handed.text: The flock was another man's to keep now. It was the first morning he could remember that it was not his.

1sam16_20.text: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

n_c2s1_gift.text: A father does not send his son before a king with empty hands.

n_c2s1_leave.text: He took the halter and went up the ridge road toward Gibeah, a shepherd sent to serve a king.

n_c2s2_intro.text: From Bethlehem the road to Gibeah runs north along the ridge: half a day, with a loaded donkey.

n_c2s2_load.text: Bread, a bottle of wine and a young goat: what Jesse sent was his house's word to the king. It had to arrive whole.

n_c2s2_jebus.text: Beside the road Jebus stood on its hill behind its walls: a strong city, and not Israel's. A traveller on this road had once said of it:

judg19_12.text: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

n_c2s2_on.text: He did not turn in. He went on toward Gibeah.

n_c2s2_dusk.text: Toward evening, where the road drops between the rocks, the wolves came down to it.

n_c2s2_gibeah.text: And as the light went, Gibeah of Saul stood above him on its height.

n_c2s2_whole.text: The bread, the wine and the young goat had come whole.
